thread:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync: we need a standard partner escalation lifecycle that covers cloud marketplace listings, hardware partner firmware incidents, and SI integration breakages. Draft proposal below.

maria.partnerships: TL;DR: 1) Detect & ACK (within 15m) 2) Triage owner & classify SEV (P0/P1/P2) 3) Open shared channel or escalate to existing partner channel 4) War room escalation rules for cross-org (when to create bridge) 5) Postmortem owner + partner comms.

alex.eng: +1. Can we map P0/P1 to SEV1/SEV2 for partners? Partners use different terms.

samir.ops: yes map table: P0=SEV1 (service down, marketplace listing failing order flow, major regression), P1=SEV2 (degraded, performance or partial outage). P0 needs immediate bridge and PD page to Redwood on-call.

jess-platform: Suggest channel naming: #partner-{partner-short}-{sev}-{region} -> e.g., #partner-acme-sev1-us. Auto-create via opsbot when PD alert triggers.

opsbot: /create-channel template triggered by pager duty incident -> link: https://redwood.internal/channels/auto/12345 (bot)

liam.sales: make sure to include partner AM and marketplace rep in initial ping. They need to sign off on any public messaging.

kate.sre: For HW partners, add firmware↔SW correlation checklist. If root cause is on-site HW, escalation includes partner field engineer contact + SI account lead.

alex.eng: What about SLAs and rollback permissions? e.g., can partner push rollback on our infra for Dedicated deployments?

maria.partnerships: Good q. Rule: Redwood ops leads rollout/rollback for hosted models. For Dedicated/private infra, partner-managed infra may have rollback rights — must be documented in the onboarding SOW and incident runbook.

samir.ops: I'll draft an incident flow diagram and a compact runbook snippet. Will include PD escalation path -> #partner-alerts -> on-call rotation and auto-bridge rules.

jess-platform: Also recommend short-lived guest access for partner SMEs in the channel (default 48h) + mandatory audit log capture and a checklist for removing access after the incident.

liam.sales: :thumbsup: Also need comms templates for marketplace status pages, joint customer statements, and partner-facing postmortems.

maria.partnerships: I'll add templates. Links (WIP): runbook draft https://redwood.docs/partnerships/escalation-lifecycle , comms templates https://redwood.docs/partnerships/partner-comms .

opsbot: Incident created: PD-7891 -> assigned to eng-oncall. Bridge link: https://meet.redwood/bridges/PD-7891

kate.sre: Timeline ask: maria, can we do a tabletop next Thurs to simulate a marketplace listing outage? Prefer to exercise the bridge + partner SME flow.

maria.partnerships: Yes — Thurs 10am PT works. I'll send invite + pre-reads (include onboarding SOW examples).

alex.eng: Quick action items: samir to post flow by EOD, jess to wire channel auto-create + guest access policy, liam to draft comms templates, kate to prepare tabletop scenario. I'll follow up on concrete rollback authority language.

maria.partnerships: Great — ping me if blockers.
